BKR.thesis_one_line: Oilfield and gas-turbine maker whose record power and LNG orders should lift profits, but its $13.6 billion Chart purchase adds debt and integration risk.
kill_criteria: Consolidated net debt (10-Q Note 8 carrying debt less cash and cash equivalents) exceeds 3.0x trailing-four-quarter Adjusted EBITDA (release Table 1a) at any quarter-end after the Chart close (my estimate at close: about 2.1-2.6x).
IET segment EBITDA margin below 18% for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: 20.6%; company target 20%).
IET book-to-bill below 1.0x for two consecutive quarters, or IET RPO below $33 billion at any quarter-end (Q2 2026: $37.1 billion).
Company withdraws or cuts its reaffirmed full-year guidance midpoint (Q2 2026 release: 'confidence in achieving the midpoint of our full-year guidance').
Goodwill or intangible impairment above $500 million tied to Chart within four quarters of the 16 July 2026 close.
key_adverse_facts: Chart acquisition closed 16 Jul 2026 at about $13.6B enterprise value; consolidated cash $15.7B and debt $16.3B at 30 Jun 2026 pre-close, pro forma net debt about $12-14B (my estimate)
Chart Q1 2026 sales -11.7% and operating income $52.6M vs $152.3M (Chart 10-Q)
Earnings guidance only held at midpoint; OFSE revenue -5% YoY; Middle East/Hormuz disruption
TTM FCF $3.36B helped by working capital and customer down payments; GAAP EPS flattered by disposal gains
data_conflicts: Yahoo/d4 EV $56.3B and FCF $4.4B predate Chart and differ from company non-GAAP FCF ($3.36B TTM)
b1 value and quality scores use the pre-Chart balance sheet
Triage said revenue decline and advance=false; orders and backlog data overturn part of that
BKR.confidence_in_thesis: med - orders and backlog are primary-source verified; Chart leverage and EBITDA are my estimates and Chart TTM EBITDA was not opened

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Restated by DV06 (2026-10-06/08): the original 5.8%/yr (FCF 2.7bn, 9% discount rate) used an unstated rate and added back stock-based compensation. With cost of equity 9.67% (10-year Treasury 5.17% + 4.5% x beta 1.0) implied 10-year FCF growth is 7.3% on 2.7bn, 8.5% with SBC deducted, 10.0% on the company-guided FY2026 FCF of about 2.2bn (Ex-99.1 0001193125-26-385823), versus my 8% base: in line to modestly above. Verdict unchanged.

BKR.scenario_basis: FY26E adjusted EPS $2.65; EPS growth 2%/12%/16% a year to FY29; exit 13x/19x/22x; dividend $0.92/yr

DE.thesis_one_line: The dominant farm and construction equipment maker is near its earnings low, but the share price already assumes a full recovery to near-peak profits.
kill_criteria: Initial fiscal 2027 net income guidance (November 2026 release) has a midpoint below $5.5 billion, i.e. no recovery from the fiscal 2026 range of $4.75-5.00 billion.
Production & Precision Agriculture operating margin below 10% for two consecutive quarters (Q3 FY2026: 13.2%).
Financial Services net income below $180 million for two consecutive quarters (Q3 FY2026: $219 million).

Equipment operations net debt (supplemental consolidating balance sheet, Equipment Operations column: borrowings less cash and marketable securities) above $8 billion (Aug 2, 2026: about $2.6 billion).
Fiscal 2026 net income guidance cut below $4.5 billion (the low end of the February and May ranges).
key_adverse_facts: Price implies about 16%/yr growth for 10 years in free cash flow after SBC (13.5% on net income, the earlier basis) from trough; about 38x FY26 guide
FY26 net income includes $382M nine-month tariff recoveries (IEEPA refunds)
Large Ag industry guided down 15-20% in US/Canada and South America
FTC right-to-repair suit settled 8 Jul 2026 with FTC oversight; cost not quantified
data_conflicts: Yahoo total debt $64.6B is consolidated including Financial Services; Equipment Operations borrowings are $9.3B
Yahoo FCF $4.5B mixes Financial Services cash flows; Equipment Operations nine-month FCF is about $3.3B
Fiscal quarters do not match calendar quarters
DE.confidence_in_thesis: high - guidance, segment and balance-sheet figures come straight from the 10-Q and releases; the main uncertainty is cycle timing

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. DV12 restatement: implied 10-year growth is 16.0% a year on FY26 equipment-operations free cash flow after SBC (about $4.1bn) at 9.06%, versus 13.6% on net income; both exceed my 9% base; base 3-year return is negative.

DE.scenario_basis: FY26 EPS $18.0 (guide midpoint $4.875B / 270M shares); EPS growth 0%/15%/30% a year to FY29; exit 18x/20x/22x; dividend $6.60/yr

RVTY.thesis_one_line: Lab-testing and research-tools maker with steady cash flow and improving diagnostics, but the price already assumes faster growth than its 4-5% outlook.
kill_criteria: Full-year 2026 pro forma adjusted EPS guidance cut below $5.30 (current range $5.30-$5.40).
Pro forma organic revenue growth below 2% for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: 3%).
Life Sciences pro forma organic revenue negative for three consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: -3%).
Consolidated net debt (10-Q Note 7 carrying debt less cash) above 3.5x trailing adjusted EBITDA (my estimate now: about 2.6x).
China Immunodiagnostics divestiture terminated or not closed by 31 December 2027 (release: 'expected to close by the end of 2027').
key_adverse_facts: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS includes about $0.11 tariff refunds, about equal to the $0.10 guidance raise
Life Sciences pro forma organic -3% in Q2; Software revenue declining
Goodwill $6.6B is 55% of total assets; net debt about 2.6x adjusted EBITDA (my estimate)
China IDX divestiture (about 6% of revenue) not expected to close until end of 2027
data_conflicts: Trailing P/E 72.6x (Yahoo/triage) is GAAP and distorted by intangible amortization; adjusted is about 28x FY26 guide
May 2026 guidance was re-based to pro forma excluding China IDX, so it is not comparable with February
Yahoo forward EPS $5.89 is FY27 consensus, not FY26
RVTY.confidence_in_thesis: med - reported figures verified; earnings-call detail and insider activity not reviewed

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Implied 10.1%/yr 10-year FCF growth exceeds my 7% base; base 3-year return is about zero. [DV36 2026-10-09: at the program cost of equity 9.56% and with SBC deducted the implied rate is 11.4-12.4%, not 10.1%; still above base.]

RVTY.scenario_basis: FY26 adjusted EPS $5.35 (guide midpoint); EPS growth 2%/8%/12% a year to FY29; exit 17x/22x/26x; dividend $0.28/yr
